summary: Grandview RV Park: operator pages + Campspot read. 14 full-hookup sites (10 pull-through to 50 ft, 4 back-in to 35 ft), 30/50 A, Wi-Fi, year-round. Campspot sells Dec 2026 nights at $39 back-in / $49 pull-through (+$2 per stay); operator posts from $45/$55. Price gate passes. Mostly nightly: 10 of 14 sites on sale online. Google 4.6 (28).
flags: PRICE GATE: pass - cheapest real RV night $39 (Campspot back-in 30/50, 2026-12-08, before tax, plus a $2 park booking fee once a stay); operator 'Starting at $45 /night'. No gateway within 40 km; not a Good Sam park. Google 4.6 (28).

LONG-STAY: mostly nightly. Campspot offers 10 of the 14 sites (2 back-in, 8 pull-through) for December nights; monthly stays (from $550) are by phone. The '10 years old ... prior approval' age rule is stated for extended stays only; a 2023 rig passes anyway. Nothing on the pages discourages nightly guests.
Back-in sites are capped at 35 ft and pull-throughs at 50 ft; a 23-ft rig fits either.
Rates: operator pages post $45/$55 'starting at' while Campspot's December quote is $39/$49; both written into fees (low from Campspot, high from the operator).
PHONE 865-604-2960 kept (matches the site). Website kept.
